verses.original: יְהוָ֣ה מָ֭לָךְ יִרְגְּז֣וּ עַמִּ֑ים יֹשֵׁ֥ב כְּ֝רוּבִ֗ים תָּנ֥וּט הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh mā·lāḵ yir·gə·zū ‘am·mîm yō·šêḇ kə·rū·ḇîm tā·nūṭ hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: The LORD reigns let the nations tremble He is enthroned above the cherubim let the earth quake
verses.literalPt: O SENHOR reina; tremam os povos. Ele está assentado entre os querubins; comova-se a terra.

verses.original: יְ֭הוָה בְּצִיּ֣וֹן גָּד֑וֹל וְרָ֥ם ה֝֗וּא עַל־ כָּל־ הָֽעַמִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh bə·ṣî·yō·wn gā·ḏō·wl wə·rām hū ‘al- kāl- hā·‘am·mîm
verses.literal: Great is the LORD in Zion He is exalted above all the peoples
verses.literalPt: O SENHOR é grande em Sião, e mais alto do que todos os povos.

verses.original: יוֹד֣וּ שִׁ֭מְךָ גָּד֥וֹל וְנוֹרָ֗א קָד֥וֹשׁ הֽוּא׃
verses.transliteration: yō·w·ḏū šim·k̲ā gā·ḏō·wl wə·nō·w·rā qā·ḏō·wōš hū
verses.literal: Let them praise Your great and awesome name He is holy
verses.literalPt: Louvem o teu nome, grande e tremendo, pois é santo.

verses.original: וְעֹ֥ז מֶלֶךְ֮ מִשְׁפָּ֪ט אָ֫הֵ֥ב אַ֭תָּה כּוֹנַ֣נְתָּ מֵישָׁרִ֑ים מִשְׁפָּ֥ט וּ֝צְדָקָ֗ה בְּיַעֲקֹ֤ב׀ אַתָּ֬ה עָשִֽׂיתָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ōz me·leḵ miš·pāṭ ’ā·hêḇ ’at·tāh kō·w·nan·tā mê·šā·rîm miš·pāṭ ū·ṣə·ḏā·qāh bə·ya·‘ă·qōḇ ’at·tāh ‘ā·śî·ṯā
verses.literal: The mighty King loves justice You have established equity You have exercised justice and righteousness in Jacob
verses.literalPt: Também o poder do Rei ama o juízo; tu firmas a eqüidade, fazes juízo e justiça em Jacó.

verses.original: רֽוֹמְמ֡וּ יְה֘וָ֤ה אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ וְֽ֭הִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לַהֲדֹ֥ם רַגְלָ֗יו קָד֥וֹשׁ הֽוּא׃
verses.transliteration: rō·wm·mū Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū wə·hiš·ta·ḥă·wū la·hă·ḏōm raḡ·lāw qā·ḏō·wōš hū
verses.literal: Exalt the LORD our God and worship at His footstool He is holy
verses.literalPt: Exaltai ao SENHOR nosso Deus, e prostrai-vos diante do escabelo de seus pés, pois é santo.

verses.original: מֹ֘שֶׁ֤ה וְאַהֲרֹ֨ן׀ בְּֽכֹהֲנָ֗יו וּ֭שְׁמוּאֵל בְּקֹרְאֵ֣י שְׁמ֑וֹ קֹרִ֥אים אֶל־ יְ֝הוָ֗ה וְה֣וּא יַעֲנֵֽם׃
verses.transliteration: mō·šeh wə·’a·hă·rōn bə·ḵō·hă·nāw ū·šə·mū·’êl bə·qō·rə·’ê šə·mōw qō·rim ’el- Yah·weh wə·hū ya·‘ă·nêm
verses.literal: Moses and Aaron were among His priests Samuel was among those who called on His name They called to the LORD and He answered
verses.literalPt: Moisés e Arão, entre os seus sacerdotes, e Samuel entre os que invocam o seu nome, clamavam ao SENHOR, e Ele lhes respondia.

verses.original: בְּעַמּ֣וּד עָ֭נָן יְדַבֵּ֣ר אֲלֵיהֶ֑ם שָׁמְר֥וּ עֵ֝דֹתָ֗יו וְחֹ֣ק נָֽתַן־ לָֽמוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: bə·‘am·mūḏ ‘ā·nān yə·ḏab·bêr ’ă·lê·hem šā·mə·rū ‘ê·ḏō·ṯāw wə·ḥōq nā·ṯan- lā·mōw
verses.literal: He spoke to them from the pillar of cloud they kept His decrees and the statutes He gave them
verses.literalPt: Na coluna de nuvem lhes falava; eles guardaram os seus testemunhos, e os estatutos que lhes dera.

verses.original: יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵינוּ֮ אַתָּ֪ה עֲנִ֫יתָ֥ם אֵ֣ל נֹ֭שֵׂא הָיִ֣יתָ לָהֶ֑ם וְ֝נֹקֵ֗ם עַל־ עֲלִילוֹתָֽם׃
verses.literal: O LORD our God You answered them You were a forgiving God to them yet an avenger of their misdeeds
verses.literalPt: Tu os escutaste, SENHOR nosso Deus: tu foste um Deus que lhes perdoaste, ainda que tomaste vingança dos seus feitos.

verses.original: רֽוֹמְמ֡וּ יְה֘וָ֤ה אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ וְ֭הִֽשְׁתַּחֲווּ לְהַ֣ר קָדְשׁ֑וֹ כִּֽי־ קָ֝ד֗וֹשׁ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃
verses.transliteration: rō·wm·mū Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū wə·hiš·ta·ḥă·wū lə·har qā·ḏə·šōw kî- qā·ḏō·wōš Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū
verses.literal: Exalt the LORD our God and worship at His holy mountain for the LORD our God is holy
verses.literalPt: Exaltai ao SENHOR nosso Deus e adorai-o no seu monte santo, pois o SENHOR nosso Deus é santo.
